items.title: A canonical map from the Chow group of k-cycles to K_0 of the quotient of coherent sheaves in adjacent dimensions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the canonical map from CH_k(X) to K_0(Coh_{<=k+1}(X)/Coh_{<=k-1}(X)) by showing that the cycle-to-K_0 map descends through rational equivalence (statement lines 3933-3945, tag 0FDS). The proof has to unwind rational equivalence into a finite cover by the integral subschemes carrying the divisors, and then, on an integral X of dimension k + 1, produce the ideal of denominators of the rational function and the two short exact sequences of coherent sheaves whose class difference represents the divisor; the final coefficient comparison needs the distance function to turn the difference of two lengths into the order of the function. Each step is a concrete construction, so the claim is H2.
